{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Doc and release note changes merely accompany the txindex code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates are secondary to the txindex feature implementation."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp and src/index/txindex.h to support index operation on pruned nodes.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Enables txindex on pruned nodes, resolving four long-standing user issues dating back to 2017 (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240). By eliminating the requirement to retain hundreds of gigabytes of raw block history for transaction lookups and proof generation, this provides durable, substantial user-facing value for node operators with limited disk space."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Extends JSONRPCError with a structured data field and updates rawtransaction and txoutproof RPCs and REST handlers to return missing block hashes.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds structured error payload handling to JSON-RPC and REST so clients can identify pruned block hashes and fetch them via getblockfrompeer. While useful for API callers interacting with pruned nodes, the interface additions directly follow from the underlying txindex feature."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The change to test_runner.py merely registers the new functional test for pruned txindex.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pin the behavior of txindex rather than modifying shared test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications in src/init.cpp only adjust initialization validation for txindex and prune flags.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Touches initialization solely to allow concurrent activation of -txindex and -prune, without altering shared utility infrastructure."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 3,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
